ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_logsigmoid_advantage_gap_sum_exp_agg_repaired
ir.intuition: Clamp exponential argument input and stabilize weighted loss by scaling and clamping to avoid numeric overflow.
ir.pseudocode:
x = clamp(alpha * scale * (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) + beta * advantage_gap, -20, 20)
loss = -logsigmoid(x)
weighted_loss = clamp(loss * weight * gamma, -15, 15)
exp_weighted_loss = exp(weighted_loss)
return sum(exp_weighted_loss) / sum(weight)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    beta = float(extra.get('beta', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('beta', 1.0)))
    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.0))
    gamma = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('gamma', 0.1))
    x = ops.add(ops.mul(alpha * scale, ops.sub(lpw, lpl)), ops.mul(beta, advantage_gap))
    x_clamped = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x_clamped))
    weighted_loss_raw = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    weighted_loss_scaled = ops.mul(weighted_loss_raw, gamma)
    weighted_loss = ops.clamp(weighted_loss_scaled, -15.0, 15.0)
    exp_weighted_loss = ops.exp(weighted_loss)
    sum_exp = ops.sum(exp_weighted_loss)
    sum_weight = ops.sum(weight).clamp(min=eps)
    return ops.div(sum_exp, sum_weight)
